selection: Authored C/headers/Makefile, original bitmap resources and score file retained. Build products, bundled compiled liblm, generated dependencies, VCS/OS metadata and course documents omitted.

files.reason: Include the existing owning video_gr.h before calling pointer-returning vg_init and vg_exit. Original implicit-int vg_init call causes a real WASM function signature trap and can truncate a 64-bit framebuffer pointer.
files.verification: Original browser traps at .Lvg_init_bitcast_invalid in graphicsStart. Owning graphicsStart regression is RED on undeclared function, GREEN with original header while preserving full returned pointer and writing the mapped framebuffer.

files.reason: Decode full signed PS/2 nine-bit X/Y motion from header sign bits before existing cursor clamp. Original plain-char cast reverses valid movements outside -128..127.
files.verification: Actual print_mouse RED on valid -255 packet, GREEN for -255,-200,-128,-127,-1,0,1,127,128,200,255 on each axis plus existing edge clamps and button transitions.

files.reason: loadScores passed100 to fgets destinations15/10bytes; unchecked copies could overflow nickname[12], atoi read unterminateddate[2], feof loop could add a phantom record and arrays of4had no capacity guard. files.verification: Actual ARM64 FORTIFY optimized compilation RED on five fgets bound violations, GREEN all11Cunits with -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=2 -O2. Actual owning loadScores real-file regression original SIGTRAP, corrected parses pinned seven originalrecords and exact date/name/score fields, a maximum11character nickname, rejects overlong/truncated/malformed records, preserves0s2sentinel and caps six valid rows to4.

files.reason: Read timer status into an unsigned long local, then assign one byte to the owning unsigned-char destination. Original cast from one-byte st to unsigned long* lets sys_inb overwrite adjacent stack bytes, including timer_set_square canary. Keep caller conf unsigned to match the existing getter signature.
files.verification: Actual ARM64 timer_set_square stack-protector abort. Owning real timer.c -O2 -fstack-protector-all regression RED SIGABRT; GREEN programs60Hz PIT control/divisor correctly, preserves16-byte guards around one-byte status, and leaves status unchanged after a failed read.
